plugins.title: HD2 Mod Console
plugins.summary: HD2 Mod Setting GUI's window: each mod's settings, with the enabled mods first.
plugins.summary_zh: HD2 Mod Setting GUI 的设置窗口：编辑各 MOD 的设置，已启用的 MOD 列在前面。
plugins.author: pat-pat-patrick

plugins.title: Asset check
plugins.summary: Each enabled mod's models and textures against the game resources they replace, and their video memory.
plugins.summary_zh: 将各已启用 MOD 的模型与贴图与其所替换的原版资源对比，并估算显存占用。
plugins.author: pat-pat-patrick

plugins.title: Model repair
plugins.summary: After a game update, brings mod models made for an earlier version of the game up to the current format so that they load again; every repair can be undone.
plugins.summary_zh: 游戏更新后，将为旧版游戏制作的 MOD 模型更新为当前游戏的格式，使其能够再次加载；每次修复均可撤销。
plugins.author: pat-pat-patrick

plugins.title: Member licenses
plugins.summary: Signs in to a mod author's site for the mods that are available only to their members, and renews the license.
plugins.summary_zh: 为仅供作者会员使用的 MOD 登录作者的网站，并自动续期授权。
plugins.author: pat-pat-patrick
